    Marks a type class instance: what given T name = ...; and given <A> T name(using ...) { ... } compile to.

    Scala's summon: Implicits.<Ordering<Integer>>summon() returns that given.
    Instances
    Type class instances for JDK types.
    Instances.CallableInstances
    Callable is a lazy effect that can be run (Effect), but not Concurrent and not FunctorFilter (a guard has nothing to drop).

    Kind<F,A>
    F applied to A: how forj writes a higher-kinded type such as "some F<A>" where F is itself a type parameter.
